[SWS_CRYPT_20004]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
X.509 Provider
shall support
ASN.1
pars-
ing. Thus it provides an
ASN.1
parser to read the specific syntax of
X.509
certificates.
Typical
X.509
certificates must follow the definition given in [34] and [35, RFC 5280]:
1. Certificate
(a) Version Number
(b)
ara::crypto::x509::Certificate::SerialNumber
(c) Signature Algorithm ID
